subject.title: ACP parent session stuck until refresh when yielded waiting for child completion

question: What should be the canonical yielded-parent wake contract across ACP, native subagents, blocked/give-up delivery, and heartbeat-disabled deployments?
rationale: Current code and related PRs show partial repairs, but the durable cross-runtime boundary affects session state, message delivery, and runtime architecture rather than one isolated bug patch.

options.title: Keep broad tracker and land slices
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical umbrella while reviewing narrow PRs like https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95776 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95080, then close only when the cross-runtime contract is covered.

options.title: Sponsor one yieldWait design
options.body: Pause slice-by-slice fixes and design an explicit persisted yield-wait lifecycle before landing more wake behavior.

options.title: Split by runtime
options.body: Make ACP, native subagent, and direct-session yield issues separate canonicals, accepting more duplicate-management overhead.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker and land slices
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical umbrella while reviewing narrow PRs like https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95776 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95080, then close only when the cross-runtime contract is covered.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent work spans heartbeat wake, system events, and subagent delivery, making this the best available routing candidate for the product boundary choice.
